title: The env guard refuses an env-file runner that prints the file through a child command
why: `uv run --env-file`, `docker run --env-file … env` and `npm exec -c env` print the env file through a child command, and hooks/guard_env.py lets them pass.
note: Filed from lane notes-fix-reverify-large (session_013NEJL4AKgUjS1CWQvcdNwc) via the coordinator, 18:31 CST Nov 7. The note on its PR names this step. Possible false alarm on main (coordinator 13:28 CST Nov 8, from this lane): `find . -name '.env' -print` is refused, although it lists paths and reads no secret.
